	AttachmentFrom as string (),
	AttachmentTo as string (),

	FailureTo as string (),
	gv_BatchDate as timestamp (),
	gv_BLBLDueDt as timestamp (),
	gv_ExtractFileName as string (),
	gv_ExtractFilePath as string (),
	gv_FileSuffix as string (),
	gv_LoadWriteoffRptTableQuery as string (),
	gv_OraclePassword as string (),
	gv_OracleProvider as string (),
	gv_OracleUserID as string (),
	gv_populatewriteoffrptquery as string (),
	gv_RCPTBLRCQuery as string (),
	gv_strDataSource as string (),
	gv_strInitialCatalog as string (),

source(output(
		BatchDate as date,
		RunDate as date,
		LastName as string,
		FirstName as string,
		MI as string,
		HCID as string,
		GroupID as string,
		ClassID as string,
		ContractID as string,
		PBP as string,
		PlanName as string,
		PlanType as string,
		CoverageType as string,
		OSBIndicator as string,
		WriteOffReason as string,
		LastDue as timestamp,
		PPAInd as string,
		WriteOffAmount as decimal(19,19),
		BillingPeriodDueDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::gv_populatewriteoffrptquery',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of LastDue} = LastDue,
		{Copy of WriteOffAmount} = toString(WriteOffAmount),
		{Copy of OSBIndicator} = toString(OSBIndicator),
		{Copy of FirstName} = toString(FirstName),
		{Copy of GroupID} = toString(GroupID),
		{Copy of PlanType} = toString(PlanType),
		{Copy of MI} = toString(MI),
		{Copy of HCID} = toString(HCID),
		{Copy of RunDate} = toString(RunDate),
		{Copy of LastName} = toString(LastName),
		{Copy of BillingPeriodDueDate} = toString(BillingPeriodDueDate),
		{Copy of WriteOffReason} = toString(WriteOffReason),
		{Copy of ClassID} = toString(ClassID),
		{Copy of BatchDate} = toString(BatchDate),
		{Copy of ContractID} = toString(ContractID),
		{Copy of CoverageType} = toString(CoverageType),
		{Copy of PPAInd} = toString(PPAInd),
		{Copy of PlanName} = toString(PlanName),
		{Copy of PBP} = toString(PBP)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of BillingPeriodDueDate} as string,
		{Copy of FirstName} as string,
		{Copy of WriteOffAmount} as string,
		{Copy of ClassID} as string,
		{Copy of ContractID} as string,
		{Copy of PlanName} as string,
		{Copy of RunDate} as string,
		{Copy of GroupID} as string,
		{Copy of LastDue} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of HCID} as string,
		{Copy of PPAInd} as string,
		{Copy of PlanType} as string,
		{Copy of OSBIndicator} as string,
		{Copy of WriteOffReason} as string,
		{Copy of BatchDate} as string,
		{Copy of LastName} as string,
		{Copy of MI} as string,
		{Copy of CoverageType} as string,
		{Copy of PBP} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
